title: $Rg_*$ has a right adjoint for proper $g$
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category and $g\colon Z\to Y$ a proper morphism.
Then the derived pushforward

$$
Rg_*=R(g_*)\colon D(Z_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)
$$

(the right derived functor [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories] of the pushforward of
[def-sfb-finite-lower-star]) has a right adjoint, denoted $Rg^!$.

proof.text: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: the unconditional ambient pro-etale exceptional adjoint is false. For a positive dimensional abelian variety E over an algebraically closed field and field coefficients, ProEtale.not_preservesColimitsOfShape_rightDerivedLowerStar_of_isAbelianVariety proves that the derived pushforward fails to preserve countable coproducts. A left adjoint would preserve them. G9 compiled the negation of the exact instance conclusion from that theorem; its axiom audit is [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. The adopted source module currently contains the legacy instance again. Its signatures and public imports are protected, and no entry of coord/upstream-statement-exceptions.tsv permits this module's correction. Unlike the historical withdrawal recorded by F3, this delivery preserves the API and the original hole and marks the instance disputed; it claims no proof or pruning. The unit's realized arrays remain empty. The active constructible exceptional functor is unaffected.
